description: This Java class 'MetricsFactory' provides a factory for creating and managing 'Metrics' instances, including caching, configuration via XML elements, and internal implementation of metrics recording and retrieval.

classes.name: MetricsImpl
classes.description: Internal implementation of the Metrics interface, providing methods to record service rate, reset metrics, and compare metrics by name.

classes.name: NullMetrics
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of Metrics that returns default values.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Metrics instance based on an XML element's attributes, with configurable estimation size, time, smoothing, and threshold.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Metrics instance with specified parameters, ensuring singleton behavior per name.

methods.name: getMetric
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Metrics instance by name, or null if not found.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns all Metrics instances sorted by name.
